identity.name: Black Bay Pro

case.bezel: fixed steel bezel with engraved 24-hour scale

identity.one_liner: A GMT Black Bay with a fixed, engraved steel bezel instead of the rotating bi-color insert on the Black Bay GMT, styled closer to an explorer-type tool watch.

narrative.story: Launched in 2022, the Black Bay Pro pairs the same GMT-capable MT5652 movement used in the Black Bay GMT 'Pepsi' with a fixed, matte steel bezel engraved with a 24-hour scale instead of a rotating bi-color insert, plus a snowflake hour hand and a red-tipped GMT hand for the second time zone. The result reads closer to a fixed-bezel GMT tool watch than to the rotating-bezel GMT-Master lineage the Pepsi model references.
narrative.collector_notes: Buyers comparing this to the Black Bay GMT should confirm the bezel is fixed rather than rotating, since the two share a movement family and case size but serve different roles as a tool watch.
